author: blu
body: Rollback netcode for real-time multiplayer games. Tracks input history per player, detects desync via state checksums, and supports rollback + resimulate when authoritative inputs arrive late. Frame-based -- each frame has a set of player inputs and a game-state checksum.

author: reek
body: The bounds live in the signature, not in a runtime assertion. The fields are declared between 0 and 3, 1 and 60, and 0 and 8; taking plain Integers here and dropping them into those fields is what CDX2051 objects to, and a __narrow would only move the check to a trap. Declared this way the caller is held to the range and the field assignment is proven.
